text: My daily routine is quite simple, but I follow it every day. I usually wake up at seven o'clock, drink a glass of water, and eat breakfast. After that, I go to work by bus and start at nine. I work until five, with a short lunch break. In the afternoon, I often exercise for thirty minutes, either running or swimming. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch TV, or read a book. I go to bed before eleven. I believe consistency is important because it keeps me healthy, organized, and energetic.
